summary: Zymeworks Inc. filed an 8-K to announce that its partner Jazz Pharmaceuticals received FDA approval for two Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii)-containing regimens in first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma. As a result, Zymeworks earned a $250 million milestone payment and remains eligible for up to $1.3 billion in additional milestones plus tiered royalties of 10-20% on net sales. This is a regulatory and commercial milestone disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. What to watch: future regulatory approvals and sales performance that trigger additional milestones and royalties.
